---
title: "Publications"
listing: 
  sort: "date desc"
  date-format: "YYYY"
  type: table
  page-size: 100
  categories: true
  sort-ui: [date]      # 仅允许时间排序
  filter-ui: true
  feed: true
  template: paper_table.ejs 
  fields: [date, title, journal, author]
  contents: 
      - publications/paper.yml 
#      categories: [] 

#page-layout: full
draft-mode: unlinked
page-navigation: false
title-block-banner: false
---

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const sortSelect = document.querySelector("#listing-listing-sort");
  if (!sortSelect) return;
  const defaultOption = sortSelect.querySelector('option[value="index"]');
  if (defaultOption) defaultOption.remove();
});
</script>
